post.description: Create an account and its first organization; returns a token so the user is logged in.
OAuth2 password flow: form fields `username` (the email) and `password`.

get.description: The logged-in user and the organizations they belong to (for the org switcher).
Everyone in the organization, with their role. Any member can see this.

schema.title: Response List Members V1 Members Get

delete.description: Access ends on the member's next request (membership is checked every time).

post.description:
Create another company owned by the logged-in user, after re-checking their password.

The client switches to it by sending the returned org_id as X-Org-Id. Nothing is copied
from the user's other companies.

get.description: The organization's audit trail, newest first. Admins and owners only.

post.description:
Queue a customer request for the agents. 202: accepted, processing happens in the
worker; poll GET /v1/workflows/{id}. A replay of the same key answers 200.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Raw retrieval (no LLM): the reranked top chunks with every stage's rank and score.
For debugging retrieval quality and for the dashboard's search box.

Ask the knowledge agents a question: query planner -> hybrid retrieval + rerank ->
answer agent -> verifier. Answers only from this organization's documents, with
citations; abstains when they don't cover the question.

Response List Transactions V1 Ledger Accounts  Customer Ref  Transactions Get

Demo customers covering every policy path, plus the customer help guide (cheques,
transfers, fraud, ...) queued for ingestion (admins; never in production).

Reject the proposed action; the workflow resumes without executing it.

get.description:
Open tickets (default) most urgent first, or resolved/all newest first.
`mine=true`: only tickets assigned to me.

schema.title: Response List Tickets V1 Tickets Get

patch.description:
take: assign to me · assign: hand off to a teammate (note recommended) · note: add a
note · resolve: close with a note (and optionally message the customer) · reopen.

Issue a customer token to open the customer app as this customer (demos and
assisted support). In production customers sign in themselves (phone + code).

get.description: Impact over the last 30 days: AI resolution rate, money returned, speed, AI cost.

Liveness: the process is up. Never checks dependencies, so a DB outage
doesn't make the orchestrator kill healthy containers in a restart loop.

Readiness: can this instance serve traffic? The load balancer stops routing to it
(503) while Postgres or Redis is unreachable.

AddCompanyRequest.title: AddCompanyRequest
AddCompanyRequest.description:
Create another company for the logged-in user. Name, email and password stay the same;
the password is asked again to confirm it's really them.

AddMemberRequest.title: AddMemberRequest
AddMemberRequest.description:
Add an existing account to the org. Email invitations for people without an account
arrive with the email tool (Phase 5).

CreateWorkflowRequest.title: CreateWorkflowRequest
CreateWorkflowRequest.description: A customer request entering the system (from a support inbox, chat, or the dashboard).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount in dispute, as written by the customer

transaction_date.title: Transaction Date
transaction_date.description: Date of the transaction if given

Details.title: Details
Details.description: Facts copied from the message. Null when the customer didn't state them.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: What the research step found in the ledger: the agents' factual basis.

KnowledgeAnswer.title: KnowledgeAnswer
KnowledgeAnswer.description:
Outcome of the knowledge agents for one question.

answered:   the answer passed citation checks and the verifier.
abstained:  no good-enough sources (decided by code), or the answer agent declined.
unverified: an answer exists but failed verification twice; a human must check it.

transaction_reference.title: Transaction Reference
transaction_reference.description: The ref (T1, T2, ...) of the debit to refund, if refunding

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why, in one or two sentences an auditor can check

record_references.title: Record References
record_references.description: For answer_from_records: the refs (T1, T2, ...) of the transactions

TransferStatus.title: TransferStatus
TransferStatus.description: For transfers to another person (IBFT/RAAST): what the payment network reports.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One neutral sentence for an operations agent

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure you are of the category

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Short justification an auditor can read

WorkflowResult.title: WorkflowResult
WorkflowResult.description: What the agents concluded. Grows a field per phase (resolution, actions, ...).

WorkflowSummary.title: WorkflowSummary
WorkflowSummary.description: One row in the workflow list: the triage headline without the step details.

HTTPBearer.description: Customer token from the customer login
